reaction: The final question neatly echoes the invitation, and the assembled fair is a satisfying payoff.

mostWorthwhile.text: Launching the whale was the most worthwhile moment: the earlier creations finally worked together as a flying fair.

leastWorthwhile.text: The initial stall setup felt routine, with little detail in the individual results.

surprise.text: The cardboard hat becoming the race finish line was a charming unexpected detail.

arbitrary.text: Joining the wind-racing game to the pinball stall made sense for opening the games, though the intermediate stall name gave little sense of what changed.

continue.text: I might continue for another inventive payoff, though the straightforward setup here offered few meaningful decisions or new mechanisms to explore.
